test_title: PYST 40: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

ABILITY : LIBAYTI : : CHRONIC : ORHCCIN : : HEAVILY : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First four letters → Written diagonally or in reverse order.
 
• **Last three letters → Written diagonally or in reverse order.**

​So,

 
• ABILITY : LIBAYTI

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/322d9fa1230a52a588c6ff4f736db9b287a0091d38b1c67579c7af02e337dc40.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eac9b098d8591830923c53b2e600cb45cecddd9f2ead180ce794f27f20b6aeb4.png] 

And,

 
• CHRONIC : ORHCCIN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5ca510c23d30618324ebb4181bd15b5b8b3f2a46ebed544836fc62550d2abf7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d139fc05379fca21bb06b97392ebb6116647b77ffcbe4e299d321b7b6b742e4.png] 

Similarly,

 
• HEAVILY : ? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f128deabb89cbe52cbc608bba4c4d902d33ac4d83ebb40a5d9ebea4962c0d4a2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fc7c64616121b13cb20bc2652bc4a741ef8e4861ba8d31b344434b5014f1316.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**VAEHYLI**".

65:T
